R package · on CRAN · MIT licensed · mostly fireproof

Raise your own
dragon.

Fine-tune your own language model on your own documents, from R. dragonfarm writes the training data for you, trains on the laptop you already have, and keeps every answer grounded in your documents with built-in RAG. No Python, no cloud. The dragon you raise is yours.

install.packages("dragonfarm")

Start hatching View on GitHub

dragon_app()

Why raise one here

Fine-tuning, without the homework.

Most fine-tuning tools assume you already have training data and a Python setup. dragonfarm starts from the documents you have.

Training data

Your documents become the lessons

It reads your documents and writes practice questions and answers. You keep the good ones and toss the rest. No spreadsheet of examples needed.

Your laptop

Trains on the machine you have

A 7B model fits an 8 GB laptop GPU, and small models learn a fixed format in minutes. No GPU? Borrow a free one in the cloud.

RAG built in

Grounded by default

It answers from your documents before you train anything, and training keeps those passages in every example. Change a document and the model follows it, without retraining.

Same dragon, same ticket

Teach it some manners.

A 0.5B-parameter model, before and after training on 190 example support tickets. This ticket was not in the training data. It is the median of the 10 held-out tickets by word overlap with the reference reply, and both replies are at temperature 0.

TicketLumen bulb pack arrived damaged. Opened my Lumen bulb pack today and the casing is split. The packaging looked fine from the outside so it must have happened before shipping.
Wild dragon (base model)I’m sorry to hear that your Lumen bulb pack has been damaged. It’s important to take any damage seriously and report it to the manufacturer or seller as soon as possible. Here are some steps you can follow: 1. Contact the Manufacturer: Reach out to the company that sold you the Lumen bulb pack. They may be able to provide a replacement or offer a repair service. 2. Report the Damage: … (shortened)
Trained dragon (after fine-tuning)I’m sorry your Lumen bulb pack arrived damaged. We will replace it at no cost. Please reply with a photo of the damage and one of the shipping label so we can file the carrier claim on our side. As soon as we have those, we ship a replacement Lumen bulb pack with a prepaid return label for the damaged unit. Usually a business day after the return is scanned in.Policy and tone are right. The last sentence mixes in a detail from another ticket type (the real policy is two business days), which is why small models still need review.

The example tickets are synthetic and built from templates, so this shows a model picking up a house style and policy, not open-ended reliability. Use your own data and check the output before relying on it.

Three ways to hatch one

Pick your nest.

Documents first, a table if you have one, the cloud if your laptop is more pebble than volcano. Everything the app does is also an R function, and every dragon lives in a plain folder you can inspect.

Documents

Feed it, then teach it

Drop in files or pages, ask anything, review the practice questions it writes, fine-tune. 

docs <- dragon_documents("policies/")
dragon_ask(docs, "How long is the
  return window?")
qa <- dragon_questions(docs)   # review
run <- dragon_train(
  dragon_questions_dataset(qa, docs),
  "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct")
App

No code, no fire hazard

Opens on Documents: drop files, ask, review the practice questions, train, try, chat. Have a table instead? One link switches to the drag-and-drop route. 

library(dragonfarm)
dragon_app()
Cloud

No GPU? Borrow a volcano.

Send the run to a free Colab or Kaggle GPU and bring the dragon home. Colab trains the example in about four minutes. 

run <- dragon_bundle(tickets,
  "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct")
dragon_remote(run, "colab")
dragon_import(run, "results.zip")

Advanced dragon training

When one lesson isn’t enough.

Preference tuning, reinforcement learning with rewards you can check, judges, chat, and publishing to the Hugging Face Hub. Treats and tough love, both included.

Fine-tune, judge, prefer, repeat

DPO and ORPO on top of a fine-tuned run, with a judge that checks the result.

Treats it has to earn

GRPO with exact, numeric, JSON, length, and test-runner rewards.

The full spellbook

Every function documented, from dragon_check() to dragon_publish().

Your first dragon is ten minutes away.

Install the package, run dragon_check(), and open the app. The first run builds the nest (a Python environment) for you.

install.packages("dragonfarm")

Start hatching
